id.description: Unique identifier for the translation task.

status.description: Current status of the translation task (e.g., 'uploading', 'processing', 'completed', 'error').

progress.description: Progress percentage of the translation task (0-100).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was last updated.

fileName.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

ownerUid.description: User ID of the task owner.

errors.description: Array of error messages encountered during the translation process.

outputs.description: Array of references to the translated output files (e.g., DOCX, PDF, TXT).

glossaryId.description: Reference to Glossary used for this translation task. (Relationship: TranslationTask 1:1 Glossary)

Glossary.title: Glossary
Glossary.description: Represents a glossary of terms used for translation.

/translationTasks/{taskId}.description: Stores translation tasks. Access is restricted to the owner of the task.

/glossaries/{glossaryId}.description: Stores glossaries. Currently public, but could be restricted by adding an ownerUid.
